newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Electricidad de Caracas approves shr div.
newsitem.headline: Electricidad de Caracas approves shr div.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan electricity company Electricidad de Caracas, which suspended dividend payments at the start of the year, has approved a new one-for-six share dividend, the company said.
Approval is still pending from Venezuela's National Securities Commission (CNV).

"The company's executive board decided in its November 27 meeting to distribute a share dividend at the rate of one for six at a date that will be announced in the press following the CNV's approval," the company said in a release to the Caracas stock exchange.
